name: venarian gold
mana cost: {X}{U}{U}
types: enchantment aura
static: enchant creature
triggered: when CARDNAME enters, tap enchanted creature and put X sleep counters on it.
triggered: at the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature's controller, remove a sleep counter from that creature.
replacement: enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step if it has a sleep counter on it.
